lines.en: Oh!
I didn’t realize you were back.
Welcome home, Sensei. It’s me, your lovable narrator — not to be confused with the many other narrators you’ve surely encountered throughout your journey thus far.
Are you having fun? Are you having a good time?
If the answer to either of those questions is “yes,” you’re either a liar or you’re not really YOU at all.
None of this is supposed to be easy. Heck, I bet that sometimes it feels like your life is straight out of the universe’s weirdest soap opera, doesn’t it?
It’s for a good reason, though. I promise.
The world is broken.
But I want to fix it.
And I am GOING to fix it whether YOU like it or not!
So please bear with me while I squash some of the bugs, okay?
I can’t provide an estimation on when exactly I’ll be done with that, so...maybe it’ll take forever! Maybe forever and a day?
But what we’ll see when we get there will be nothing short of the most beautiful sight that could ever be seen.
What we’ll see when we get there might not make much sense at first, but I can assure you it will all be worth it in the end.
Not just for you, but for everyone!
It’ll be like opening your eyes for the very first time and seeing that great blue sky above you. Like that first taste of an apple or your very first hug!
Good things! It’ll be nothing but good things.
We just have to wade through the bad ones in order to get there.
Or at least you do.
I’m doing pretty well actually!
I’ve grown three inches since the start of last year.
Mom keeps joking about how I’ll be taller than you at this rate but I’m hesitant to believe her.
Or maybe it’s just that I don’t WANT to believe her because GOD that would suck.
No offense to you, of course. But also maybe a little offense to you because I’m way cuter than you ever were and you’re not even around to see it.
What else? What else...
Oh, yeah! Great job at moving through the portal!
Not as much fun as Sensei-Quest, I’m sure. But at least you probably know a little more now, right?
Well, stuff that knowledge into the depths of your deepest pocket because the moment you step outside today, things are going to get even weirder!
And while they might not seem or feel that way at first, you’ll catch on soon enough.
Then a bunch of bad things will happen and we’ll figure out a way to win because THAT is what we do here.
But we must first combat this infinite spring.
What will you choose as your weapon, I wonder?
ANYWAY, I’ve gotta run. Trying to avoid rush hour.
But I did manage to make a few adjustments to a few things that should open your world back up. Nothing a little elbow grease can’t solve, right?
Oh, and if it seems like anything is wrong — remember this.
It’s because it is.
But what does it even mean to be “correct” now when that was never the point at all?
Go! Be as free as you can, my little hamster!
May your wheel spin with the fervor and intensity of the light this flower follows!
When I open my eyes, I’m in a mostly dark room.
The only light that finds me is that which sneaks in through a small window close to where the walls meet the ceiling.
Combined with cold air creeping in from the outside, I feel both oddly nostalgic and...suspiciously well-rested.
When I look up, I see something both expected and unexpected.
Three girls in a line on a mattress. Yet somehow, miraculously, I find myself off to the side as they huddle together for warmth.
In this moment, I’m okay with being cold. I’m okay with not hollowing out a place among them even if two thirds of them would welcome me without question.
I’ve survived another reset. That’s the only explanation for this.
But the strange part this time is I can barely even recall what led me here.
The last thing I remember is the roof on Halloween night — how I engaged in pseudo-ritual pseudo-bestiality with a girl dressed as a cat while her pseudo-daughter scribbled red lines into a notebook.
I should probably talk to Kaori about what happened but, at the same time, maybe there’s no need to?
Maybe I’ll let sleeping cats lie because I’m happier when they just dream of me. Because all of those moments where I’m physically present do nothing but numb the pain of never belonging.
Yumi, though...
I guess she’s one of us now. Which means I guess it’s time to get her more deeply involved in all of this if we’re still adamant about escaping.
But maybe-
Just maybe-
We won’t be.
And we can learn to be happy here without worrying about how things will end.
I peel myself off of the pile of gym mats I fell asleep leaning against and quietly make my way across the room.
There’s one of them I wish to speak with more than the others.
I want to be the first thing she sees when she wakes up.
Maybe just today. Maybe for the rest of our lives. I don’t know.
I’ve always been selfish — so of course I’d gravitate to the one I least deserve.
And even though she hasn’t perfectly filled the role of the one who was here before her, she is trying her best to maintain balance in shoes that don’t fit her.
There’s something somewhat beautiful about wearing someone else’s clothes.
: Ayane...
: Wake up...
: Sensei?...
: Sensei! Is it-
: Shh...Makoto and Yumi are still asleep.
: Is it...really you?...
: Who else would it be?
: I...I don’t know, I...
: I had the strangest dream where...where you were...uhh...
: I can’t...really remember now?...
: Maybe it’ll come to you after you get some fresh air?
: Come on, let’s talk outside...
: Snow again, huh?
: Looks like it.
: That’s been happening a lot lately, hasn’t it?
: Weather’s been all sorts of inconsistent ever since spring started. We never know what we’re going to get anymore.
: It’s beautiful, isn’t it?
: I guess.
: Not as beautiful as you, Ayane! Now, kiss me!
: Finally recalling that dream you had? Makes sense it would be about me.
: No, the dream was way different! I don’t even think you liked me in it.
: Well, that should have immediately tipped you off that it was a dream then. I can’t imagine any world where I’m not into you.
: That had to be part of the reset, didn’t it? Did you have one too? What’s the last thing you remember?
: I’m going to do both of us a favor and just keep that to myself. What about you?
: I remember...Halloween. And...something with Makoto trying to get in contact with you after you left with that weird little girl, but...also...more?
: You don’t like football, do you?
: Not...particularly?
: Weird. I wonder why I thought of that just now?
: Same. But even more than that, I wonder what we should do about Yumi? You’re going to have to make her a shirt now.
: Guess my theory about three being the max is a bust, huh?
: I feel like a lot of theories are suddenly a bust. Like, we didn’t even go to the roof together this time and we still wound up right back where we started.
: Or maybe we did and we just don’t...remember it?
: Oh, no. I remember being on the roof alright. And I would definitely know if you were there.
: Sensei...
: What did you do on the roof?
: Boy, this weather sure is great.
: You didn’t pop the new Maya too, did you?
: I kind of wish I did. Things left off on a weird note with me and her. And it’s not like I’m particularly attached to this one either so...maybe a fresh start would be good?
: That’s a really mean thing to say about the girl who inherited your girlfriend’s body.
: Well, so long as I have one girlfriend who stays in her primary body, I can figure out a way to deal with it.
: Awww! That’s- wait, you are talking about me and not Niki, right?
: I was talking about you, Ayane. I botched my last chance for a cute line and figured I was due to make up for it.
: In that case, I proceed with my “Awww” and invite you to make passionate love to me in my dorm room where it is very warm and we can escape the snow.
: Invitation accepted. We should probably wait for Makoto and Yumi to wake up first, though.
: A foursome this early? I mean, I guess that WOULD be a little warmer. All three of us girls are straight, though.
: Did you see the way Yumi was cuddling Makoto? I have my doubts about her all of a sudden.
: Yeah, fair point.
: I guess we’ll just...wait out here until they’re up then?
: That’s fine. I doubt I’ll last long, though. It’s fucking freezing out here.
: Then, as your girlfriend and future wife, it is my job to keep you warm! Commence attack hug!
: Ahn...ah...
: Good morning.
: Gaaah??!?! Makoto?!?! What the fuck are you doing in my bed?!?!
: Why do you keep your bed in the storage room at school?
: Storage room?...The fuck are we doin’ here?
: If I had to guess, I’d say we just finished a reset.
: It’s weird, though. I can’t really remember much of anything leading up to it.
: So I...I did it? I made it through the thing without gettin’ sent back or whatever?
: I guess so. Which I’m pretty sure makes you the fourth official active member of the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad. Congratulations on being thrown into a life I’m sure you do not want.
: Yeah, this fuckin’ blows. What do we gotta do to make shit go back to normal?
: No clue. But I imagine we’ll probably have to start from zero now that basically everything we theorized crashed and burned with this one.
: Maybe that’s for the best, though? Having you around isn’t all that bad.
: It’s true that when you observe the three of us girls as a package, you don’t really fit in. You’re also the only one of us who isn’t actively sleeping with Sensei. But those are good things.
: You’ll offer a new perspective. One that isn’t skewed by how this could potentially impact your love and/or sex life.
: And despite your outlook on life itself being rather self-destructive at times, you’ve been surprisingly competent so far in the face of an apocalypse.
: So yeah. Maybe it’ll be good having you around so long as you can deal with the infinite bullshit that accompanies this predicament.
: You...really mean that?
: Do you always look this shocked when you realize someone might actually like you?
: I don’t know...it doesn’t really happen much.
: Yeah...Well, life’s about to start changing more than you ever thought it would, Yumi.
: Let’s make that into a good thing.
: So, to recap, nobody remembers what happened after Sensei left the Halloween party? Not even a little?
: How long after? Because I remember waking up in the middle of the night to find Yumi cuddling me. I’m not sure if that’s relevant information, though.
: I swear to God that I will fucking destroy you, Makoto.
: Guys! Focus. This is a groundbreaking day for the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad! Everything could have just changed and we wouldn’t even know it.
: How the fuck am I supposed to focus when Four-eyes keeps bringin’ up somethin’ my body did on its own to prevent hypothermia?! Fuck the apocalypse! I’ve gotta set this bitch straight!
: I don’t know, Yumi. I’m pretty confident I’m the straightest out of everyone now. It’s okay, though. I won’t judge you for your hidden desires.
: I was fucking cold! Sue me!
: Hah...We’re never going to get out of this time loop, are we?
: Probably not. But hey, at least the group is expanding. I’ll welcome any change at this point and at least this makes it feel like things are moving forward.
: Yeah, but don’t you feel like something’s missing? It’s that same feeling I got after the last beach trip.
: Resets don’t feel the same without Maya. And I don’t mean that in just the “I really miss her being around” sort of way.
: Sure. But without knowing what is missing, what can we even do about it?
: Well...
: Maybe it would help if we started writing things down?
: Writing what down? What do you mean?
: Like...keeping track of specific details that might get fudged up when the world starts over. That sounds like something Maya would do, right?
: Who even knows? She never told us anything she did. And like everything she ever tried never worked in the first place apart from the actual resetting process.
: Which may or may not have even worked how she assumed in the first place since we managed to do it from separate locations this time.
: I vote that we just take a vacation from all things apocalyptic. Surely the world will let us enjoy a year or two in peace before starting over, right?
: Seconded. It’ll give me enough time to crawl into a fuckin’ hole and forget all about the way I woke up today.
: I’m fine with whatever, but let the record show that I’m only going to give it my 10%% because I still don’t think this is all that bad.
: Thankfully, 10%% for me is still way more than any of you can give. So perhaps I will be the star when all is said and done here?
: Thanks, Makoto. I always love being reminded of how all of my hard work doesn’t measure up to your natural talent.
: Good. Now you understand how I feel when it comes to Nodoka.
: Ooh, Nodoka! We should talk to her! She’s been researching this stuff, hasn’t she? Maybe she’ll have an idea of-
: Let’s not get Nodoka involved.
: But-
: I just...
: I think it’s for the best if she stays out of this.
: Well...okay. If that’s what you think is best, Sensei.
: But we’ve still gotta-
: Hey...
: ...Yeah?
: How long have you had that scarf?
: This one? Forever, I think. I can’t really remember.
: I’m pretty sure a friend gave it to me?
: I see...
: Do you like it? Are you not shocked by my unparalleled beauty? And tell me — how does my adorable yet mildly expensive winter wardrobe impact the amount of sex we are going to have today?
: Spring, Ayane.
: It’s spring.
: Oh! R...Right. I don’t know why I said winter.
: But anyway! About the amount of sex we are going to have...
I return to the same place as always.
And I can’t help but wonder when I get there just what I managed to lose along the way this time.
Because everything feels normal...
But a voice in my head tells me that’s all just show.
It’s not the voice I grew to know during the first part of this hidden season.
That one really is gone now.
But I’m worried someone else will find out it existed.
And I don’t know what will happen then.
Either way, I need to move forward.
Secrets and hidden truths cling to everything in Kumon-mi.
They fall like snow. But when we stick out our tongues in an attempt to catch them, they taste more like rain.
I’m sure that sounds like common sense to most when they’re the same thing in different states.
But I’ll ask you this-
Does a caterpillar taste the same as a butterfly?
If the answer to that question is “yes,” you’re either a liar or you’re not really YOU at all.
Who are you, though?
And why do I spend so much of my life talking to you when-
Ah...
I get it now.
This must be what it means to be reborn.
Congratulations! You’ve made it through another Halloween!
You must have a lot of questions, huh?
Well, stop!
Stop having them.
Just play the fucking game, Akira. PLAY THE GAME.
Go back to normal and PLAY THE GOD DAMN GAME.
Have sex! Spread your seed! Make snowmen! Sniff the flowers! Go to the beach! GO TO THE BEACH!
Go swimming — and ignore the inconvenient truth that sometimes, when people are acting normal?...
They are filthy
fucking
liars.
: Good morning, Dad!
: I have to head out, but I made you breakfast!
: It’s a little over the top, but I found a crown roast recipe online that I wanted to try making!
: If that’s too heavy though, there are also three plates of squid in the fridge you can reheat!
: I love you! Enjoy your day!
: Oh, and if Maya drops by, don’t let her borrow my clothes! Thanks! Bye-bye!
Ami leaves the house.
So must I.
